pr_title: fix(html): render text attachments as text

issue_context.title: [BUG] HTML Reporter Renders Plaintext Attachments as Base64 Encoded Text
comments: @rwoll I'd prefer both 1 and 4 at the same time. This allows to attach a text file, as well as just a string. As for the internal representation, we'll keep iterating on it in the future anyway.

A combination of your options make sense to me:
- don't lose the binary bit in `raw.ts`. It does not need to be JSON-serializable atm
- `html.ts` should produce the 'model' for the report, it should contain information in the exact form it will be displayed (inline vs attachment). All binary files (based on mime type) should become files and all textual should go inline. `html.ts` will do the decoding.

Thanks for tackling this @pavelfeldman! Sorry I wasn't able to get to it! Just saw the MR as I was going through emails!

Excited to consume this in 1.18 for local/offline reports!! The HTML report that gets opened on failure continues to be SUPER useful and friendly! 🎉

review_comments: Agreed, but it is the right thing to do here...
